exposure: having two or more living children
not receiving a free Long-Lasting Insecticidal Net at the first Antenatal Care
factors related to the organization, availability, and quality of health services
outcome: completion of the maternal health care continuum (defined as 4 antenatal visits, skilled birth attendance, and postnatal care within 42 days of delivery)
proportion of women who had completed 4 antenatal visits
proportion of women who delivered under the care of qualified personnel
proportion of women who received postnatal care within 42 days of delivery
cohort: Women who had recently completed a pregnancy and were assessed for their maternal healthcare continuum in the five communes of Conakry, Guinea.
finding: Only 26.9% of women completed all stages of the maternal health care continuum in Conakry, with key factors for discontinuity including lack of education, unemployment, multiparity, and not receiving a free insecticide-treated net at the first antenatal care visit.
